brief.topic: Want your money to work while you sleep? Meet compound interest. Each year you earn interest not just on what you saved, but on the interest you already earned. Put one thousand dollars away at seven percent. In ten years it nearly doubles. In thirty, it's over seven times bigger. So start early, add a little every month, and leave it alone. Even ten dollars counts. Follow for part two.
notes: Show the growth as a chart: $1,000 → $1,967 (10 years) → $7,612 (30 years)
